resources.string: Use the signed-in session for extraction

While signed in, the video requests are signed by your Google session, the way yt-dlp uses cookies — YouTube reads them as signed-in ones and the bot check rarely comes up. Streams and everything else are untouched
The dislike count comes from the Return YouTube Dislike community. Your own dislike still goes to YouTube.
The open video\'s title and thumbnail come from the DeArrow community when it has a better one. Videos keep their creator\'s own otherwise.
A button under the video that silences it and brings the sound back
A button under the video that repeats it instead of letting it end
A button under the video that copies its title, description or link; a video\'s hold menu gains Copy link
Shared links leave out the tracking parameters YouTube adds, like “si”
Hardware decoders are never created; every stream decodes in software. For devices whose decoders crash
Videos in this codec are skipped; another codec plays them, or only the sound does
MediaCodec is created without its async callback loop — for devices that crash on it
